requirements.summary: Generate a new QR code image that encodes the actual deployed website URL for Friends AC Services
acceptanceCriteria: QR code encodes the actual website URL
QR code is scannable and directs users to the live website
Image has sufficient resolution for clear scanning

file_operations.description: Create a QR code image that encodes the Friends AC Services website URL with high error correction and clear contrast. The image will be generated at 300x300 pixels for optimal scanning. This replaces the existing qr-code.dim_400x400.png that currently shows the app identifier.

requirements.summary: Update the Footer component to display the new website-specific QR code
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays the new QR code image
QR code maintains existing styling and positioning
Label clearly indicates it links to the website

file_operations.description: Update the QR code image source to reference the new website-specific QR code at frontend/public/assets/generated/website-qr.dim_300x300.png instead of the current qr-code.dim_400x400.png. Update the accompanying label text to clearly indicate the QR code links to the Friends AC Services website. Maintain all existing Footer styling, layout, and other content unchanged.

requirements.summary: Render the generated website QR code image as a static asset for use in the Footer component
acceptanceCriteria: QR code image is saved in frontend/public/assets/generated
Image is properly referenced in Footer component
Asset loads correctly when the page renders

file_operations.description: Ensure the generated QR code image file frontend/public/assets/generated/website-qr.dim_300x300.png is available as a static asset and properly accessible via the public path /assets/generated/website-qr.dim_300x300.png when the Footer component references it.
